title: Topic 22
japanese_text: 「デフレ」とは、物価が<u>持続的</u>に<u>下落</u>している状態を指す。反対に、物価が<u>上昇</u>し続けることを「インフレ」と呼ぶ。デフレは、経済が停滞している状態を指す「<u>不況</u>」とよく混同されるが、デフレだからといって、必ずしも不況だとは限らない。
english_translation: The term "deflation" refers to a state in which prices suffer a sustained decline. Conversely, when prices continue to rise, it is called "inflation." Deflation is often confused with "recession," which refers to a state of economic stagnation, but deflation does not necessarily mean recession.
